title: Structure-Guided Design of Artificial Transcription Factor for a Progesterone Biosensor.
authors: Liu, Kun; Fan, Xinlan; Zhao, Ming; Chen, Yu; Tang, Qinghui; Wei, Shenghua; Xue, Zhenglian; Wei, Dongzhi; Wang, Feng-Qing
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟结构引导设计人工转录因子ProB用于孕酮生物传感器，聚焦TF-DNA结合域与激活域组装及合成启动子调控，属于蛋白质-DNA互作建模在TF体系中的应用，但偏重工程应用而非机制深度研究。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) can be used in genetic circuits and biosensors in the field of synthetic biology. Traditionally, TFs derived from prokaryotic organisms are transferred to more complex eukaryotic cells to achieve gene control; however, TFs in eukaryotes are rarely transferred to prokaryotes. Herein, an artificial TF responsive to progesterone was designed through MD simulations, and the linker fine-tuned the convergence of the DNA-binding domain and activation domain as the desired conformation guide to design an artificial TF ProB assembled from the QF(DBD), the ligand-binding domain, linker, and QF(AD). The ProB acted on the synthetic promoter QT, which is composed of QUAS, 10-bp space, T7, and the RBS, which controlled the transcription of the biosensor GFP in E. coli. The performance of the whole-cell progesterone biosensor was optimized via a bacterial enrichment strategy, which made the biosensor highly sensitive (LOD 0.15 mug/L and EC(50) 26.58 mug/L), preferably in the working temperature range (20-30  degrees C), with only a 56.4 min detection time and a working concentration range of 0.15-40 mug/L, and the performance reached the requirements of clinical application. This report presents effective strategies and valuable insights into the design of non-natural TFs and their artificial systems in prokaryotes.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）可用于合成生物学领域的基因电路和生物传感器。传统上，源自原核生物的转录因子被转移到更复杂的真核细胞中以实现基因控制；然而，真核生物中的转录因子很少被转移到原核生物中。在此，通过分子动力学（MD）模拟设计了一种对孕酮响应的人工转录因子，并通过连接子微调DNA结合域和激活域的收敛性，作为所需构象的指导，组装出由QF(DBD)、配体结合域、连接子和QF(AD)组成的人工转录因子ProB。ProB作用于合成启动子QT，该启动子由QUAS、10-bp间隔、T7和核糖体结合位点（RBS）组成，控制了大肠杆菌中生物传感器GFP的转录。通过细菌富集策略优化了全细胞孕酮生物传感器的性能，使其具有高灵敏度（检测限0.15 μg/L，半数有效浓度EC(50) 26.58 μg/L），在20-30°C的工作温度范围内表现良好，检测时间仅需56.4分钟，工作浓度范围为0.15-40 μg/L，性能达到了临床应用的要求。本报告为非天然转录因子及其在原核生物中人工系统的设计提供了有效策略和宝贵见解。
